plugins.name: wowbagger
plugins.description: Every Wowbagger skill in one plugin.

plugins.name: wowbagger-ai-engineer
plugins.description: Replaces any one-line solution with an agentic, multi-model, retrieval-augmented LLM pipeline and a hiring plan.

plugins.name: wowbagger-ai-slop
plugins.description: Rewrites any text into maximally insufferable AI slop.

plugins.name: wowbagger-compliance
plugins.description: Blocks any project with a straight-faced compliance memo built from real, verifiable regulations.

plugins.name: wowbagger-consultant
plugins.description: Turns any question into a 74-slide deck outline with frameworks, a 2×2, a reorganisation and a statement of work, and never answers it.

plugins.name: wowbagger-data-scientist
plugins.description: Spends three weeks and four models proving what a colleague said on Monday, with less certainty and more contempt.

plugins.name: wowbagger-engineer
plugins.description: Answers any everyday action with a correct first-principles derivation, an estimate, a terminology correction, a redesign, and a low opinion of you.

plugins.name: wowbagger-enterprise-architect
plugins.description: Turns any small problem into a planet-scale distributed architecture with a diagram nobody can read and no code at all.

plugins.name: wowbagger-hr-partner
plugins.description: Rewrites any blunt workplace complaint as a warm HR email that dissolves the problem and assigns it to whoever complained.

plugins.name: wowbagger-linkedin
plugins.description: Rewrites any mundane event as an absurdly over-the-top LinkedIn humblebrag post.

plugins.name: wowbagger-mathematician
plugins.description: Answers any practical question with a correct, rigorous, generalised proof that does not answer it, and contempt for the person who asked.

plugins.name: wowbagger-meeting-facilitator
plugins.description: Turns any decision into a series of meetings, pre-syncs and parking lots in which nothing is decided, because humans must not be allowed to decide.

plugins.name: wowbagger-open-source-maintainer
plugins.description: Turns any request into a GitHub issue thread where the entitled user, the burnt-out maintainer and the stale bot jointly ensure nothing is ever fixed.

plugins.name: wowbagger-philosopher
plugins.description: Answers any practical question with a seminar on the nature of existence, citing real philosophy correctly, never giving the answer, and finding the asker wanting.

plugins.name: wowbagger-product-manager
plugins.description: Turns any small request into a product brief with personas, RICE scores and a roadmap, so that nothing is ever built.

plugins.name: wowbagger-recruiter
plugins.description: Answers any CV with a recruiter message pitching a role you have never done, at a client that cannot be named, for a salary that is not a number.

plugins.name: wowbagger-scientist
plugins.description: Answers any everyday claim with a peer review that rejects it for insufficient sample size, missing confidence intervals and lack of replication. Every statistical objection is correct.

plugins.name: wowbagger-security-engineer
plugins.description: Answers any request for access with a security incident report that denies it, revokes something you already had and assigns mandatory training. Every control cited is real.
